title: On Unix, a delegated child's descendant processes have no guaranteed cleanup after a natural exit or a cancel
outcome: On Unix, a delegated child's runtime and MCP descendants are reliably cleaned up after a natural exit or a cancel, with a single owner of the reaping wait, matching the Windows job-object guarantee of the cancelled-child cleanup work.
acceptance: On Unix, a delegated child's descendant processes have no guaranteed cleanup after a natural exit or a cancel is done
